official_text_status.note_en: No article has been independently verified against the official Umm Al-Qura text in this repository build. Points that cannot be verified from the provided PDF are flagged NEEDS_OFFICIAL_TEXT_CHECK.

official_arabic_foundation.note_en: Foundation for the official Arabic statutory text (the future canonical legal source). A full USER-PROVIDED Arabic text candidate has been ingested and segmented into 281 article records; it is NOT yet verified against Umm Al-Qura or the Bureau of Experts. Authoritative operational record: data/official_arabic/ingestion_status.json (article records: data/official_arabic/companies_law_m132_1443_official_arabic_user_provided.json). Design/verification docs: docs/official_arabic_text/.

official_arabic_foundation.source_publication_reference: Companies Law issued by Royal Decree No. (M/132), dated 1443/12/01 AH
official_arabic_foundation.reviewer_notes: The full Arabic Companies Law text and the scanned PDF packet were owner-provided from the official Bureau of Experts at the Council of Ministers source and together form the controlling source packet (see boe_source_provenance). Source-provenance confidence is separated from article-by-article automated verification: no direct automated article-by-article verification against live BOE HTML has been performed (direct automated capture was blocked or unsuitable), so article_by_article_verified stays false and articles_verified stays 0, and no article may be marked verified. The current internally-reviewed Arabic summaries must not be treated as official statutory text. OCR of the scanned packet is supporting evidence only, not the source-confidence gate. Arabic remains governing.

boe_source_provenance.source_authority: Bureau of Experts at the Council of Ministers
boe_source_provenance.note_en: Owner-provided Bureau of Experts Arabic text + scanned PDF packet are the controlling source packet. Provenance confidence is separated from article-by-article automated verification, which has NOT been performed. OCR is supporting evidence only, not the source-confidence gate.

copyright_note_en: This repository contains concise reference summaries and structured metadata. It does not reproduce the full official Arabic statutory text beyond what is necessary for reference, consistent with the user-provided translation source.
